coverage.evidence: QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:73-74 sends quote, quote.text, quote.author, quote.game and quote.date to NumberedAsync. That needs exactly one input which ComposingRows.TryPosition accepts (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:87-91). TryPosition is a trimmed NumberStyles.None whole number of at least 1 (ComposingRows.cs:45-46, ParsedArgument.cs:24-28), so a space is fine and #12, 0 and -3 fail. quote.count and quote.latest render only with zero inputs (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:62-68).

{quote:n} prints the number and the line in quote marks (QuoteText.cs:21, QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:104). text, author and game come from QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:100-102. The date prints as yyyy-MM-dd (QuoteText.cs:45). quote.count is TotalCount (QuoteReader.cs:44-48). quote.latest is the first item of a list sorted newest number first (QuoteReader.cs:51-55, QuoteService.cs:211). A null result prints as written (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:107-108, TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19). The Said by, Game and Said at labels are in dashboard/src/views/dashboard/quotes/i18n/en.json:27-30, and the row shows the number at QuoteRow.vue:32.

ComposingRows.cs:33 gives the quote rows TemplateHelperContexts.Standard. TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22 defines that as every context except Viewer. In viewer text a key that is not allowed returns null (TemplateResolver.cs:157-158), so it prints as written.

Each numbered helper reads its own input and looks up the quote by number (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:87-93, QuoteService.cs:150-162). quote.count and quote.latest return text only and set no shared number (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:62-68). {quote.author} with no input fails the one-input check (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:88). A missing quote prints the braces around the rendered content, such as quote:99 (RenderedToken.cs:29, TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:117-118). args.1 is the first word (ArgumentKeys.cs:18).

A missing author or game gives an empty string (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:101-102), while a missing quote gives null and stays as written (QuoteService.cs:162, QuoteReader.cs:31). With no quotes, the count is a successful TotalCount of 0 (QuoteService.cs:207, 230-232) and latest is null (QuoteReader.cs:54). The date uses the channel time zone, falls back to UTC, and is empty with no QuotedAt (QuoteText.cs:37-55, TemplateRenderScope.cs:34).

reader_answers.evidence: There are five numbered forms and two forms with no input (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:62-74, 97-105). The number is the per-channel Number shown on the Quotes page (QuoteRow.vue:32).
The helpers work in the Standard contexts but not in viewer text (ComposingRows.cs:33, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22, TemplateResolver.cs:157-158).
A missing quote returns null and prints as written (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:107-108, TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19). A missing author or game gives an empty string (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:101-102).

Both helpers render the same {args.1} input first and look up the same quote number (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:108-115, QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:87-93). An unknown number prints {quote:99} (RenderedToken.cs:29, TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:117-118). {quote.author} with no input stays as written (QuoteTemplateHelpers.cs:88).
